title: In CPI week, only Wednesday actually moves

hero.caption: bigger range on **CPI Wednesday** than a quiet Wednesday. Every other day trades like a normal week.

chart.label: How much each day moves vs a normal week
chart.sub: Above the dotted line = bigger range than a normal week · below = smaller
chart.note: Wednesday is the print. The rest of CPI week is flat — Thu/Fri are actually calmer than usual.

useIt: Wednesday is the only day worth treating as a CPI day. Don't size up Monday or Tuesday expecting fireworks — the "whole week is hot" idea isn't true anymore. And even Wednesday is a bigger range, not a cleaner trend.
disclaimer: Not advice · AI-backtested on 10y NQ · check it yourself
